tests.ignored_case: q4_rowwise_one_token_prefill: existing WASM-only ignored native test; not counted as passed

limitations: Raw LM speed, not complete Agent runtime; heads/grammar/tools excluded.
CPU workers use private weight/heap copies; total 514.19-525.56 MiB with 8 resident helpers plus coordinator and SAB, excluding JS/process RSS.
GPU dense f32 weight and QDQ-f32 KV buffers use about 335.73 MiB, excluding driver/process RSS.
Five-round focused heuristics selected from same-machine exploration; validation of speed, not held-out device tuning.
GPU decode ~3% difference has limited practical magnitude; prefill 512 differences overlap observed variation.
Workgroup size is not physical core count; Worker scheduler cannot pin performance cores.
